label: Teltonika RUTM08
description: Industrial wired router, no modem: 1x 1 GbE WAN, 3x 1 GbE LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUTM08 datasheet: **1x WAN and 3x LAN, all 10/100/1000 Mbps**, and **no cellular modem at all** - the M08 is the wired member of the RUTM family, which makes it a firewall/VPN endpoint rather than a failover router.
